parties.host: Whoever runs OpenClear: the bank when it hosts OpenClear itself, or its hosting provider

evidence.automated: OpenClear's own data shows whether it operates; a test can attest to it for a period
evidence.assisted: OpenClear supplies the evidence (a report, an export, a recorded review); a person judges it
evidence.attested: outside what OpenClear can see; a person attests, and may attach evidence

cuecs.title: Provision and remove staff
cuecs.statement: Approve each staff member's access before adding them, change it when their job changes, and deactivate them in OpenClear (or in the bank's identity provider) by the bank's own deadline when they leave.
cuecs.complements: OpenClear grants only what a person's security group allows, records every membership change in the action log, and stops a deactivated person signing in or using a token at once.

cuecs.title: Keep the identity provider in step
cuecs.statement: When staff sign on through the bank's identity provider, keep its group mapping and SCIM provisioning in step with the bank's directory, so someone disabled there is disabled in OpenClear.
cuecs.complements: OpenClear applies SCIM deactivations and group changes as they arrive, and refuses a sign-on the identity provider refuses.

cuecs.title: Review staff access
cuecs.statement: At least quarterly, review each staff member's security group, customer scope and account access, remove what's no longer needed, and record the review.
cuecs.complements: OpenClear exports every membership with its group, scope, account access and last sign-in, and records each change.

cuecs.title: Give the least access a job needs
cuecs.statement: Decide who holds admin permissions and keep them few; use customer scope and per-account access where a role is narrower than the whole bank; don't give day-to-day deciders admin permissions.
cuecs.complements: OpenClear checks every request against the person's permissions, scope and account access.

cuecs.title: Separate conflicting duties
cuecs.statement: Design security groups so no group combines conflicting duties, then move segregation of duties from warn to enforce.
cuecs.complements: OpenClear checks groups against the bank's conflict rules, refuses a breach under enforce (ERR_SOD_VIOLATION) and logs it under either mode, and never lets whoever presented an item decide it.

cuecs.title: Use dual control on decisions
cuecs.statement: Turn on dual control for pay/return decisions where the bank's policy needs a second person, and staff it so a checker is available before every cutoff.
cuecs.complements: OpenClear holds a recommended decision until a different person approves it, and records both.

cuecs.statement: Have a second admin approve every change to matching rules and scoring models, and approve only changes the bank has assessed.
cuecs.complements: Under enforce, OpenClear holds a rule or model change until another admin approves it, and records both people.

cuecs.title: Offboard customers that leave
cuecs.statement: When a customer leaves the bank or stops positive pay, set its last service day in OpenClear, stop the core sending its items, and keep the records the bank must keep in the core, which is the system of record.
cuecs.complements: OpenClear ends the customer's sign-in and refuses its accounts' items after the last service day, and deletes its data 90 days later with a signed certificate, unless it's on legal hold.

cuecs.title: Screen for sanctions where the money moves
cuecs.statement: Screen accountholders, people cashing checks, payees where the bank's risk assessment calls for it, and inbound IAT parties for OFAC sanctions in the core, teller and ACH systems. A pay decision in OpenClear isn't an OFAC clearance.
cuecs.complements: OpenClear doesn't screen for sanctions. It shows the payee as issued, as read from the image and as typed at a branch, so a bank can check one when it has reason to.

cuecs.title: Govern the scoring model
cuecs.statement: Before turning fraud scoring on, inventory the bank's model under its model-risk or AI policy, tier it and name an owner; while it's on, review its metrics, champion/challenger record and replays at least yearly, and turn it off if they degrade.
cuecs.complements: OpenClear keeps scoring off until the bank turns it on, activates a model only after 200 of the bank's own decisions, learns only from decisions people made, and shows each model's metrics and how it was chosen.
